As of November 1 in Saudi Arabia, 516 persons with suspected severe RVF* requiring hospitalization have been reported
The mean duration from disease onset to hospitalization was 3.3 days (standard deviation [SD]= ±3.2 days)
Of the 216 suspected severe case-patients with appropriate serum samples, 206 (95%) have been laboratory confirmed
516 persons with suspected severe RVF* requiring hospitalization have been reported
the average time from disease onset to death among the 87 fatalities was 6.3 days (SD= ±5.3 days)
RVF anti body prevalence > 90% was found in Al Ardah district.

public_health_question.v: What are the magnitude, clinical features and likely exposures and vectors of the 2000 Rift Valley fever outbreak in Saudi Arabia?

ev.q: This report updates the findings of the ongoing investigation conducted by the Saudi Arabian MOH in collaboration with CDC
Update: Outbreak of Rift Valley Fever --- Saudi Arabia, August--November 2000
This report updates the findings of the ongoing investigation conducted by the Saudi Arabian MOH
Suspected cases have been identified through an elaborate pre-existing system of primary health-care centers
Based on preliminary data from the ongoing epidemiologic investigation, 125 (76%) of 165 case-patients reported close contact with animals
A regional survey for RVF antibody prevalence in domestic ungulates, primarily goats and sheep, was conducted in Jazan and Asir provinces.

equity.level_reason: Citizenship (Saudi, Yemeni, other) is reported only as a descriptor of cases, alongside sex and age; no group-specific outcomes are reported.

level_alternative.reason: Citizenship of cases could be read as a routine case characteristic in an international outbreak report rather than an SPD descriptor.

ev.q: 424 (82%) were Saudi citizens, 80 (16%) were Yemeni citizens, and 12 (2%) were of other nationalities
the median age was 46 years (range: 1--95 years)

notes: Descriptive outbreak update; the stated 'correlation' between case areas and flood-irrigation areas is a qualitative spatial observation, not a computed statistic. The Saudi-Yemen comparison is explicitly declined by the authors.
view_issues: Province shares sum to over 100% (Jazan 365 [77%] plus Asir 122 [24%] of 516; 365/516 is 71%). Figure 1 shown only as an image.
